result.markdown:
(Current LTS) **Node.js v26.13.0 (Lithium)**

As of **November 11, 2026**, Node.js 26 is the latest Active LTS release.

- **Latest LTS\:** v26.13.0
- **Codename\:** Lithium
- **LTS status\:** Active LTS
- **Expected end of support\:** April 30, 2029

Other supported LTS branches\:

- Node.js 24.x – Maintenance LTS
- Node.js 22.x – Maintenance LTS

**Recommendation\:** Use Node.js 26.13.0 for new production projects.

**Download\:** [Official Node.js download page](https://nodejs.org/en/download)\.

To check your installed version\:

```bash
node --version
```
